# LOKI Infra (Loki Infrastructure & Developers)

> LOKI Infra is a construction project management consultancy (PMC) headquartered in Surat, Gujarat, India. It manages high-value industrial and commercial construction on the owner's behalf: construction management, contract administration, cost control, quality and safety, and testing, commissioning and handover. LOKI Infra focuses on Gujarat and delivers projects across India. It is part of the Siddh Sai Corporation group, which has worked in construction in Surat since 1993.

Key facts:
- Type: Project Management Consultancy (PMC) for construction
- Headquarters: Piplod, Surat, Gujarat 395007, India
- Service area: Gujarat (primary), all of India
- Sectors: factories and industrial plants, warehousing and logistics, commercial offices and IT parks, retail and hospitality, healthcare and education, residential townships, roads and civil works, solar
- Engagement models: full PMC, construction-stage PMC, design and build (turnkey) through group execution teams
- Founded: 2022, Surat
- Parent group: Siddh Sai Corporation (est. 1993, Surat), 500+ projects completed by the group
- LOKI Infra project: Gujarat Smart School Project, Limbayat, Surat (2022-23), a 12-month renovation covering painting and waterproofing, structural repair, landscape development and replacement of doors, windows and locks
- Group projects (Siddh Sai Corporation): Zota Healthcare factory and warehouse, SEZ Surat; 16 power loom factories (units 30-45), PTO Sachin GIDC; industrial construction in Sachin GIDC; Inorbit Mall Vadodara (RCC roads, plastering, false ceilings, fabrication, flooring); bus depot renovation, Vadodara; turnkey residential projects in six Vadodara localities; low-rise buildings in Lavasa City, Maharashtra; electrical and street lighting for GEB, MSEB, RVUN and MPPGCL; Anganwadi buildings in rural Madhya Pradesh; waterproofing across Gujarat, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan
- Leadership: Mr. Sanjay Shinkar (Lifetime Director, founded Siddh Sai Corporation in 1993), Mr. Lokesh Shinkar (Founder and Director, LOKI Infra)
- Contact: info@lokiinfra.com, +91 73593 59310
